name: Issues
tagline: Issue list, issue page and new-issue form
summary: A repository's issue list with filters and bulk close or reopen, the issue page with description, labels, timeline and comments, and a new-issue form.

flow.label: Issues list route
flow.note: Turns the status filter into an API state and asks for one page of 30 issues.

flow.label: getIssuesFromRepo
flow.note: Lists the repo's issues over REST and drops pull requests from the result.

flow.label: Issue detail route
flow.note: Prefetches the page data without blocking and takes the tab title from a cached list row.

flow.label: getIssuePageData
flow.note: One GraphQL query for the issue, its comments and first timeline page; REST if that fails.

flow.label: IssueDetailContent
flow.note: Lays out the title, description, activity timeline and the properties sidebar.

flow.label: updateIssueState
flow.note: Closes as completed or not planned, or reopens, with the user's token; caches refresh after.

features.name: Repository issue list
features.summary: Open issues by default, with status, author, label and updated filters, sorting, search and 30-per-page paging.

features.name: Bulk close and reopen
features.summary: Select rows to close as completed or not planned, or to reopen. Issues already in that state are skipped with a reason.

features.name: Issue page
features.summary: The title paints at once from a cached list row; description, comments and events follow as one timeline that loads more on demand.

features.name: Issue labels
features.summary: Toggle labels from the sidebar with an optimistic update, or type a new name to create a label with a random colour and apply it.

features.name: New issue
features.summary: Uses the shared draft page: title, body prefilled from the repo's issue template, @mentions of collaborators, assignees and labels.

issues.note: Predates the cache rebuild (#193, #206). Worth re-testing before it stays open.
